component.name: Simple File Explorer
component.summary: A small, fast file manager for Wayland

description.p: Simple File Explorer (sfe) is a minimal file manager written in C with GTK3. It covers what a daily file manager needs while staying small and readable.

ul.li: A sidebar with places, bookmarks, drives and a folder tree
Up to three split views, grid or list
Fuzzy search, thumbnails and batch rename
Vim-style keys, a command line and undo
Follows the GTK theme and reloads generated colour schemes instantly

screenshot.caption: Folders, a sidebar with drives and the folder tree

description.p: Fixes two crashes in the command line completion and a view in an unreadable folder (such as /root) that could not be focused or closed.
File icons can follow the theme's colours: folders in the accent colour, or one-colour icons, chosen in Settings with a preview of each style.
